statement: One metric falls in v2.1 and it falls on purpose. The theme's no-silent-shrinkage gate rejects any drop over 5 percent, which is the right default for a broken collection run and the wrong answer for a deliberate tightening of what counts as a published price. This manifest authorises that one drop, names its size, and expires with this release.

applies_to.note: The gate honours an entry only when the incoming value matches `to` within `tolerance_pct`. A manifest cannot licence an unbounded fall, and it cannot be reused by a later release: `release` must match the version in the metrics file.

approved.reason: the publication gate changed, not the market

decomposition.step: hosts with at least one priced row, the v2.0 rule, measured on the v2.1 snapshot
decomposition.note: the frame grew. Under v2.0's own rule this release would report 241, not 211.

decomposition.step: minus rows that fail evidence or plausibility
decomposition.note: every published number must now appear word for word in a quote captured from the provider's own page, with its currency and its cadence, inside a per-unit plausibility band. This is what removes the CPO/EU day rate built from a year read as a price, and the CPO/EU hourly figure that appeared in no quote at all.

decomposition.step: minus rows outside the fractional-executive scope
decomposition.note: SaaS seat prices and outsourced bookkeeping subscriptions. The CFO/US monthly median moves from $1,499 to $2,500 once they are out.

decomposition.step: minus duplicate rows within a host

not_shrinkage.note: rises. The 65-site fractional-*.com network was consolidated to one operator, which removed 64 host rows, and collection since 2026-09-02 added more than that. All 64 consolidated hosts published no price, so the consolidation moved the provider count and left every median untouched.

verification.acceptance_gate: 40-record random samples drawn at seeds 20260903 and 20260904 from records-v2.1.csv, re-fetched live: 30 of 30 and 34 of 35 reachable records carry their number, currency and cadence on the provider's page today. Combined 64 of 65, 98.5 percent, against a 95 percent threshold.
